extensions.name: Project System
extensions.description: Manage complex projects, break them down into tasks, set deadlines, and track progress.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Auto Read Reminders
extensions.description: Automatically reads out reminders when navigating dates with arrows.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Date Calculator
extensions.description: Calculates the number of days between the currently selected date and today.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Developer News
extensions.description: Stay updated with the latest news and announcements from the developer team.
extensions.author: Novarealm

extensions.name: Developer Toolkit
extensions.description: Heavy-duty developer tools: REPL Console, Event Sniffer, Live Log Viewer, Extension Inspector & Hot-Reloader, HRK Packer.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: My Diary
extensions.description: Secure diary and notes extension with mood tracking.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Ghost Taskbar Cleaner
extensions.description: Cleans up ghost icons left behind in the Windows System Tray.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Key Notifier
extensions.description: Plays sounds when CapsLock or NumLock state changes.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Lumina
extensions.description: Birthday reminders for friends, family and yourself. Lumina lights up your calendar with the moments that matter most.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Markdown Reader
extensions.description: Open, read, and navigate Markdown (.md) files with full screen reader accessibility.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Quotes
extensions.description: Fetches and reads random quotes from Novarealm API.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Smart Launcher
extensions.description: Create customizable URL/command selectors with their own hotkeys. Replaces Mail Selector AHK.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Wikipedia Reader
extensions.description: Search and read Wikipedia articles directly from Hariku
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Window Teleporter
extensions.description: Teleport to virtual desktops and pin windows for instant Alt-Tab ninja navigation.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Routines
extensions.description: iOS-Shortcuts-style automation: run a chain of actions automatically when conditions are met (time, battery, idle, focused app, clipboard, network) — or on demand with Run Now. Manage them from the Routines window.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Filter
extensions.description: Search and filter your reminders and events across all dates. Find anything instantly with keyword search.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Google Calendar Reader
extensions.description: Read your Google Calendar events inside Hariku. One-way sync: reads from Google, edits stay local.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Quick Expand
extensions.description: Auto-expand custom typed abbreviations (like 'my_email') into full text templates globally across Windows.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Weather
extensions.description: Hear the current weather and a 7-day forecast for your city. Choose the city in Preferences, Weather. Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (no account or API key needed).
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Morning Briefing
extensions.description: Hear a short spoken briefing: a greeting, today's date, today's reminders and news from other extensions such as the weather. Optionally plays the first time Hariku starts each day.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Finance
extensions.description: Track income and expenses offline: balance and summaries, history by month and category, monthly budgets with spoken warnings, recurring transactions, and an optional daily reminder. Understands amounts like 20.000, 20rb or 1,5jt.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: World Clock
extensions.description: Hear the current time in cities around the world. Press the World Clock hotkey to speak every zone, or open the window to browse them. Manage your cities in Preferences.
extensions.author: Rafli

extensions.name: Hariku Account Manager
extensions.description: Sign in with your InfiArtt account (infiartt.com). Provides identity for extensions with online features.
extensions.author: Hariku Core Team

extensions.name: Flight Radar
extensions.description: Hear the aircraft flying near your city: the nearest few on a hotkey, a list of everything in range, and optional announcements when one passes overhead. Choose the city in Preferences, Flight Radar. Aircraft data by adsb.fi and adsb.lol, flight routes by adsbdb.com (no account or API key needed).
extensions.author: Rafli
